card.name: Attachment and sensitivity words in dental/skin text
card.fires_on: Prepositions like onto, to, on after bonded, cemented, allergies or seen, and partway through drug names like Clodan, calcineurin, iodine, ANZUPGO. Mostly in dental and skin-treatment passages.
